verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents API endpoints to create, fetch, update, and delete templates, and it advertises merge-field personalization, which covers the template-management and variable parts of the story. The evidence never shows template versioning, and no cited send-endpoint doc states that a send can be triggered by template id with a variable payload. Missing for 10: template versioning via API, documented send-by-template-id with variable substitution payload, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, version, and update email templates through the API and trigger sends by template id with variable payloads

citations.quote: Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
Personalize content with merge fields and conditional logic.
This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
